    "arxiv_categories": {"primary": "cs.DC", "cross_list": []},
    "title": "FASER: Fine-Grained Phase Management for Speculative Decoding in Dynamic LLM Serving",
    "summary": "FASERは、online continuous batching下で従来の投機的復号がbatch全体へ同じspeculative lengthを与え、draftとverificationを直列実行するため、低負荷ではGPUが遊休し高負荷ではreject suffixのverification計算を浪費する問題を扱う。requestごとの適応的投機長、target中間層でreject suffixを予測して打ち切るtoken-wise early exit、verificationをFrontier chunkへ分割してdraftとGreen ContextでSM空間多重化する機構をvLLMに実装する。Azure由来arrival trace、ShareGPT/LongBench/HumanEval、H100上で、既存方式比throughput最大53%向上・latency最大1.92倍短縮を報告する。",
    "list_summary": "request別投機長、verification中のreject早期除去、Frontier単位のdraft/verify同時実行で動的負荷へ適応し、vLLM上でthroughput最大53%向上。",
    "authors": ["Wenyan Chen","Chengzhi Lu","Yanying Lin","Dmitrii Ustiugov"],
    "authors_affiliations": "Nanyang Technological University Singapore、Shenzhen Institutes of Advanced Technology (CAS)、University of Chinese Academy of Sciences。",
    "published": "2026-04-22",
    "publication": "arXiv:2604.20503v1",
    "publication_type": "プレプリント",
    "publication_status": "arXiv v1。",
    "lineage": "speculative-decoding",
    "topics": ["投機的復号","continuous batching","adaptive drafting","early exit","GPU spatial multiplexing","vLLM"],
    "importance": "高。SD algorithmだけでなくserving runtimeのbatch/load変動へdraft・verify両phaseをrequest/token/chunk粒度で適応させる。",
    "hardware_evaluation": "2×NVIDIA H100 96GB実機。",
    "hardware_details": "Qwen3-0.6B/32Bは1 H100、Llama3.2-1B/Llama3.3-70Bは2 H100 TP=2。PCIe4、CUDA13.1、AMD EPYC Milan 64-core、256GB host。",
    "quality_effect": "speculative decodingのaccept/recovery semanticsを保持し、Frontier resetでreject後も正しいprefixから再開する。",
    "storage_targets": ["draft/target model states","speculative token frontier","online profiling/controller state"],
    "bottlenecks": ["batch共通固定speculative length","reject suffixへの無駄verification","draft/verification直列化によるSM遊休","動的arrivalによる最適設定の変動"],

{
  "schema_version": 1,
  "transport_version": 10,
  "slot": "problem_method",
  "attempt_id": "attempt-d3e86eed6060f69be7fa32ff",
  "job_id": "job-research-57d78e1392b6c354",
  "data": {
    "problem": "dynamic online trafficではbatch sizeとrequestごとのacceptance特性が激しく変わるが、既存SDはbatch単位固定speculative lengthとdraft→verifyのbarrier実行を使う。低負荷ではdraft待ちでtarget GPU資源が余り、高負荷では最終的にrejectされるsuffixまでtarget全層を通して計算を浪費する。",
    "novelty": "speculative lengthをrequest単位でonline探索し、target中間層のdraft/target Top-K logits類似からreject suffixをtoken単位で早期pruneする。さらにverification prefixをFrontier chunkとして逐次commitし、draft/targetへSM shareを割当てて同GPU上で並行実行する。",
    "method_overview": "Adaptive Drafterはbatch size・SM割当・最近のacceptance/latencyからcommitted token当たりcostを推定しGP-LCBでrequest別lengthを選ぶ。Early ExiterはLinit以降の中間層でTop-K signalを非同期評価しreject予測token以降を次層から除外する。Frontierはverification可能prefixをchunk化し、targetが現在chunkを検証中にdraftが次chunkを生成する。reject時はaccepted prefix+recovery tokenをcommitして後続speculationを破棄・再開する。",
    "components": [{"name":"Adaptive Drafter","description":"recent serving contextごとにrequest別speculative lengthをGP-LCBで選び、acceptanceとverification costを釣り合わせる。"},{"name":"Token-wise Early Exiter","description":"target中間層の軽量Top-K signalでreject suffix開始点を予測し、不要tokenを後段layerから除外する。"},{"name":"Frontier + Green Context overlap","description":"verificationをchunkへ分割し、draft/targetをSM空間分割してproducer-consumer型に同時実行する。"}],
    "system_design": "vLLM continuous batchingへruntime controllerとprofilerを統合。offline profileはbatch size・token length・SM allocation別latencyを収集し、online controllerがlength/SM share/chunkingを更新する。"
  }
}

    "methodology": "Qwen3-0.6B/32BとLlama3.2-1B/Llama3.3-70BをShareGPT、LongBench、HumanEvalで評価。arrival patternはDynamoLLMで使われたAzure LLM invocation trace由来、平均26 req/s、各60秒×5回。SpecInfer、AdaSpec、Smurfsを比較。",
    "scope": "実GPU dynamic trace replay。追加でEAGLE/Medusa self-speculative decodingとQwen2 MoE pairへの一般化を評価。",
    "workloads": ["ShareGPT","LongBench","HumanEval","Azure-derived dynamic arrivals"],
    "baselines": ["SpecInfer","AdaSpec","Smurfs","vanilla/fixed-length SD","EAGLE","Medusa"],
    "metrics": ["throughput","latency","early-exit ratio","profiling MAPE","runtime overhead"]
  }
}

{
  "schema_version": 1,
  "transport_version": 10,
  "slot": "results",
  "attempt_id": "attempt-d3e86eed6060f69be7fa32ff",
  "job_id": "job-research-57d78e1392b6c354",
  "data": {
    "overview": "主要dynamic-serving評価でthroughput最大1.53倍（+53%）、latency最大1.92倍改善。Qwen3 LongBenchでlatency最大48%減、Llama3 LongBenchで42%減。early-exit単体はlatency 26%減/throughput 1.22倍、Adaptive Drafterはlatency最大19%減/throughput1.35倍。",
    "key_results": [{"metric":"throughput","value":"最大1.53倍（+53%）","baseline":"state-of-the-art SD systems","condition":"Qwen3 dynamic workloads","interpretation":"load変動に応じたlength/phase制御でproductive concurrencyを維持。"},{"metric":"latency","value":"最大1.92倍改善","baseline":"state-of-the-art SD systems","condition":"dynamic arrival traces","interpretation":"early exitとdraft/verify overlapでcritical pathを短縮。"},{"metric":"early-exit opportunity","value":"reject suffix predictor accuracy最大95%、verification計算約25%回避・latency最大19%減（motivation）","baseline":"full verification","condition":"batch32, speculative length6","interpretation":"reject予定tokenをtarget全層へ通す必要がない。"},{"metric":"generalization","value":"MoEでlatency16%減、throughput1.38倍","baseline":"Smurfs","condition":"Qwen2-0.5B/57B-A14B, 2 H100","interpretation":"dense model以外にも機構が有効。"}],
    "negative_results": "profilingモデル誤差はdraft latencyで最大17.2%程度。Green ContextでSMを分割してもHBM/cache階層は共有されるためmemory contentionは残り、overlapは予測gainが干渉を上回る場合だけ有効。",
    "interpretation": "SDの最適点はalgorithm固定値ではなく、batch/load/acceptanceとGPU slackに応じて変わるため、serving runtimeがphaseをrequest/token/chunk粒度で制御する必要がある。",
    "quality_impact": "accept/reject semanticsを保つため、正しく実装された範囲で生成分布を変えない。"
  }
}
